# Cafe QR POS & Accounting Software

Cafe QR is a powerful, yet simple, Point of Sale (POS), billing, and accounting software designed for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, retail stores, and general businesses. It includes an integrated zero-commission online delivery website generator.

## About
Cafe QR provides complete ERP solutions, allowing business owners to generate GST-compliant tax invoices, track inventory, manage customer credit ledgers, and handle full accounting/expense tracking from a single centralized dashboard.

## Core Features
- POS & Fast Billing: Generate bills in seconds. Perfect for quick-service and retail.
- Accounting & Expense Tracking: Maintain financial records, daily sales, and profit margins.
- Free Online Delivery App: Zero-commission branded website for online orders and takeaways.
- Digital QR Menu: Table-based QR code self-ordering for dine-in customers.
- Inventory Management: Multi-variant stock tracking (by size, weight) and low-stock alerts.
- Offline Billing: Continue billing even without internet; data syncs to the cloud automatically.
- Multi-Kitchen KOT Routing: Send orders directly to kitchen thermal printers.
- Hardware Support: Native support for ESC/POS Bluetooth and USB Thermal Printers.

## Target Audience
- Restaurants, Cafes, and Fine Dining
- Bakeries and Confectioneries
- Grocery Stores and Supermarkets
- Fashion and Apparel Retail
- General Businesses requiring simple billing and accounting software

## Payment Integrations
Supports Razorpay, UPI QR Codes, Credit/Debit Cards, Netbanking, and Cash on Delivery.
